utterances.speaker: MR. STRINGER
utterances.text: Mr. President, just one brief question that may be of assistance.

utterances.speaker: MR. STRINGER
utterances.text: If you can, Witness R, describe the difference between the HVO patch and the HV patch worn by soldiers of the Republic of Croatia.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS R
utterances.text: They were almost identical. The only inscription under it was different. For the Croatian army from Croatia, the Republic of Croatia, there was an "HV". And for those from Bosnia-Herzegovina, it was an "HVO". But the insignia was almost exactly the same.

utterances.speaker: MR. STRINGER
utterances.text: Nothing further, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Seric.

utterances.speaker: MR. SERIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. I believe that there is some interest for the Defence in this question, and this is really not as kind of a response to the questions asked by either Her Honour or my learned friend.

utterances.speaker: MR. SERIC
utterances.text: Let me ask you something else. Since you specialised in military analysis, the use of military units, the size of units, its maneuverability, its covering of certain terrain and the issues of subordination and so on, can we agree that you specialise in these issues and can discuss them?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS R
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. SERIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Mr. Seric, I think there should be an end to the questioning of the witness. When I asked whether there were any questions out of Judge Clark's questions, that means you have to concentrate within the scope of the questions asked by Judge Clark. It's not to give you another chance for the cross-examination, you have to bear this in mind.

utterances.speaker: MR. SERIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, my apologies. I'm not seeking to have the last word here. You will definitely have it. But the questions of Her Honour Judge Clark were so to the point and so surgically correct and pointed to the essence of military analysis that I felt that this was a necessary question to ask to make as a point.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you, Witness. Thank you for helping us by giving the evidence. The usher will show you out when he pulls the blinds down. Mr. Stringer, do you have any documents to handle at this stage?

utterances.speaker: MR. STRINGER
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. President. At this time the Prosecutor tenders Exhibit P198.1 and Exhibit P262.1. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: And those documents are tendered under seal, I suppose.

utterances.speaker: MR. STRINGER
utterances.text: Yes, thank you, Mr. President, that's right, because they do name the witness. They should be under seal.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: May I know the initial response from the Defence counsel?

utterances.speaker: MR. KRSNIK
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, my apologies, but the Exhibit 5 -- I don't know exactly the number. Unfortunately, the Defence did not have an opportunity to see it, due to all the difficulties which I have just described. My binders are at home, are being analysed, so I don't have them handy here. So I cannot review them right now. But if you allow me until tomorrow morning, after I've had a chance to review the document tomorrow morning, early, first thing, I can tell you whether we have any objections to it or not.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Seric.

utterances.speaker: MR. KRSNIK
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. SERIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] We have no objection to the introduction of this -- to the admission of these documents.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. We'll adjourn until 9.30 tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: 4.01 p.m., to be reconvened on Wednesday, the 19th day of September, 2000, at 9.30 a.m.
